Nusrat Bhutto used state necessity to validate that historical takeover.

Free and compulsory education is for children aged five to sixteen.
National Assembly: at least twenty-five. Senate: at least thirty.
Forty consecutive days of the House’s sittings without leave; the House may declare the seat vacant.
For the National Assembly, the presiding officer means the Speaker.

HISTORICAL QUESTION: “Governments” completes the former Article 184(1). The current November 2025 text omits Article 184 and assigns this jurisdiction to the Federal Constitutional Court under Article 175E. Remember the historical wording without treating it as current Supreme Court jurisdiction.
Membership is open to other peace-loving states accepting the Charter obligations and able and willing to carry them out.
Nine judges constitute a quorum. The full Court has fifteen members.
Sunnah is a primary source in the classification used by this syllabus.
The missing category is administrative law. The question asks for Salmond’s classification, so keep the named author in view.
Hukm shar‘i means the legal rule or ruling. Its study concerns the conceptual structure of Islamic law.
An authority imposes the precept and enforces obedience. “Sovereign only” is narrower than this definition.
Agreement is the key: persons or states agree on rules regulating their conduct towards each other.
Section 10 concerns a previously instituted qualifying suit and stays the trial of the later suit. Section 11 addresses res judicata.
Civil jurisdiction is general, except when cognizance is expressly or impliedly barred.

The statutory wording is “shall”. It bars a further High Court revision against the District Court’s order under subsection (2). Read the applicable edition and provincial amendments for a current practice question.
Judgment gives the reasons for a decree or order. The decree is the formal adjudication of rights.
His consent is required. The rule concerns adding a plaintiff suing without a next friend or someone as next friend for a plaintiff under disability.
Any qualifying court where a portion is situated may hear it, provided the entire claim is within that court’s pecuniary competence. “Any court” does not remove these conditions.
The institution named in the bar is the High Court. This repeats the idea tested in question 18.
The application asks the court that passed the ex parte decree to set it aside. Success depends on the rule’s requirements.
An appeal is preferred by a memorandum signed by the appellant or pleader.
Ta‘zir is punishment other than qisas, diyat, arsh or daman.
The words give meaning to the raised-stick gesture so that B apprehends imminent criminal force. This can be assault without physical contact. Mere words alone do not constitute assault.
Force compelling, or deceit inducing, a person to go from a place describes abduction.
The punishment can extend to five years, or fine, or both, for the specified mischief involving irrigation or diversion of water.
Where there is no wali in a case of qatl, the Government has the right of qisas under this provision.
Investigation collects evidence through police or another authorised person other than a Magistrate. Inquiry has a different definition.
A private person may arrest someone who in their view commits a non-bailable and cognizable offence, or a proclaimed offender. Both offence characteristics matter.
A complaint is the specified allegation to a Magistrate with a view to action. It excludes a police officer’s report.
For this chapter’s definition, adult means a person who has attained eighteen years.
The appeal goes, with the opinions, before another judge of the same court. The eventual judgment follows that judge’s opinion under the provision.
A previous judgment legally preventing cognizance or trial is relevant to deciding whether the new proceeding can be entertained.
“Not proved” means neither proved nor disproved. This is a middle category, not the same as disproved.
Proceedings before an arbitrator are excluded from the Order’s stated application.
Evidence may be given of facts in issue and relevant facts.
A mental condition of which a person is conscious is included within “fact”. Facts are not confined to physical objects.
Statements about the cause of death or circumstances of the transaction causing death are one category covered by Article 46. The Article also covers other specified statements.
A relies on C’s will to displace B’s possession. A bears the burden on that assertion.

On the plaintiff’s application after the plaintiff takes the stated oath, the defendant is called to deny the claim on oath. Read this special procedure with the rest of Article 163. Article 163 excludes Hudood enforcement and other criminal cases under clause (3).
The Order is numbered through Article 166. Later inserted lettered provisions should not be confused with the conventional exam count.
Statements of witnesses permitted or required before the court on matters of fact are oral evidence.
The advocate must uphold the dignity and high standing of the profession as well as their own.
The prohibition addresses an advocate. Read the rule’s limited allowances for ordinary professional cards and directory entries separately.
The exact statutory word is “proper”. The other choices are close synonyms, so this is a wording question. Fee division is allowed with another advocate on the stated division-of-work basis.
Junior and younger members should be respectful to seniors; seniors should assist juniors.
The forbidden acquisition is an interest adverse to the client in property or interests involved in the case.
